mistake_reason: At step 5, the Assistant concluded that Vacation Rentals have the higher average rating based on a truncated, preliminary snippet from page 1 that explicitly indicated continuation on the next page and missing values (e.g., B&B was cut off). The Assistant failed to ask FileSurfer to fetch the remaining page or request clarification on the finalized averages, and instead proceeded with assumptions. This matches FM-2.2 (Fail to Ask for Clarification), as the agent acted on incomplete and ambiguous data without seeking additional information or confirmation.
